title: "Assignment: Logistic regression & model validation"

**Data:** NHANES: diabetes ~ age + BMI + physical activity

## What this assignment practices
- Fit a logistic regression and report odds ratios with CIs
- Present crude and adjusted ORs side by side
- Evaluate predictions on held-out data
- Describe how a prediction model can treat groups unfairly
